title: Why Hazel Is Slow: A Thousand Cuts
question: Why is Hazel slow? Cyrus asked; Matthew says death by a thousand cuts, and wanted more substance behind that idea. 2026-11-08.
measurements: None of its own: the costs measured in reports 001 to 047, as a ledger (data/ledger.json), with the quoted numbers checked against their reports; the Witch's small edit from report 046's runs.
